topic.description: 关注中国经济、外交、安全、产业链与海外利益

overview: 今日专题“中国与世界”。共筛选 23 个高价值事件，重点关注中国相关进展、美国相关进展及全球外交、经济与安全动态。

featured.titleZh: 民主党胜选或对华施压；顶尖数学家离开美国：南华早报七大要闻
featured.summaryZh: 本周要闻回顾包括美国中期选举后民主党大胜，可能在人工智能等领域对华施压。同时，北京表示将继续致力于与华盛顿建立建设性的战略稳定关系。
featured.whyImportant: 美国政局变动对中美双边关系及全球科技竞争格局产生了深远影响。

featured.title: Australia faces same issues that flipped control of US Congress in midterms, experts say
featured.summary: Anthony Albanese’s government has taken a blow due to Iran war but voter anxiety around cost of living and datacentres may hit harder Get our daily political email, free app or daily news podcast The Democrats’ stunning midterm victory should broaden Australia’s alliance with the US, observers say, even as a new power base emerges in Washington, affecting Aukus, datacentre development and relations with China. Cabinet ministers, diplomats and Australia’s defence industrial sector closely watched the results this week, with control of the US Congress flipping to the Democrats and the outlook for Donald Trump’s final two years in office badly dinted. Continue reading...
featured.titleZh: 专家称澳大利亚面临与美国中期选举中导致执政党失利相同的议题
featured.summaryZh: 美国民主党在中期选举中获胜，引发澳大利亚政界对美澳联盟及AUKUS协议未来走向的关注。专家指出，生活成本压力等议题正同时影响两国的政治格局。
featured.whyImportant: 美国国会控制权的更迭直接影响澳大利亚的国防工业布局及对华外交政策。

featured.title: Hong Kong’s Exchange Fund earnings tumble 74% as HKMA warns of more market turbulence
featured.summary: Hong Kong’s Exchange Fund, the war chest used to defend the local currency, reported a 74 per cent tumble in third-quarter earnings amid pervasive market uncertainty, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) said on Friday. Earnings totalled HK$18.6 billion (US$2.4 billion) in the quarter, plunging from HK$70.8 billion a year earlier. For the first nine months of 2026, total earnings slid 39.6 per cent from a year earlier to HK$171.9 billion. The Exchange Fund’s Hong Kong equities portfolio...
featured.titleZh: 香港外汇基金收益暴跌74%，金管局警告市场将持续动荡
featured.summaryZh: 香港金融管理局报告称，受市场不确定性影响，第三季度外汇基金收益同比大幅下滑74%。前九个月总收益较去年同期下降近四成。
featured.whyImportant: 外汇基金收益的波动直接关系到香港金融体系的稳定及应对货币市场风险的能力。

featured.title: EU’s Southeast Asia push hits funding crunch as China widens lead
featured.summary: An EU funding crunch is threatening to stifle the bloc’s ambitions to expand its influence in Southeast Asia, as Brussels grapples with a budget deadlock that could slow infrastructure investments across the fast-growing region. The funding squeeze could hinder the green transition and regional connectivity goals of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations, even as Brussels seeks greater strategic autonomy amid competition with Beijing’s economic clout. Analysts expect the European Union to...
featured.titleZh: 欧盟对东南亚投入面临资金瓶颈，中国影响力持续扩大
featured.summaryZh: 欧盟因预算僵局导致对东南亚基础设施投资受阻，可能影响该地区的绿色转型与互联互通。在与中国经济影响力的竞争中，欧盟的战略自主目标面临挑战。
featured.whyImportant: 资金短缺可能削弱欧盟在东南亚地区的地缘政治影响力，并改变区域基础设施建设的竞争格局。

featured.title: US military expands Pacific cyber hub to counter risks to undersea cable networks
featured.summary: The US military has expanded its cybersecurity presence in Hawaii and set up a regional centre to better detect threats and disruptions to its Pacific communications networks. The new initiatives come amid US accusations of Chinese cyber operations targeting critical infrastructure, including on Guam, and concerns about the security of undersea cables linking the Pacific to the US mainland. Neither initiative has been explicitly linked to China. Brigadier General Michael Smith, US Pacific...
featured.titleZh: 美国军方扩大太平洋网络中心，以应对海底电缆网络风险
featured.summaryZh: 美国军方在夏威夷扩充网络安全力量并设立区域中心，旨在加强对太平洋通信网络威胁的监测。此举背景涉及对关键基础设施安全及海底电缆脆弱性的担忧。
featured.whyImportant: 随着地缘政治紧张局势加剧，保护关键通信基础设施已成为美军在太平洋地区战略部署的重点。

featured.title: 5 months’ jail for helper convicted of molesting employer’s 12-year-old daughter
featured.summary: A Hong Kong court has sentenced a domestic helper to five months in jail for molesting her former employer’s daughter in the family home. Lady Jay Santos Flores, 45, did not submit any mitigation to Kowloon City Court on Friday before she was sentenced on three counts of indecent assault. She sobbed occasionally during the hearing. Flores was convicted last month of molesting the child, who said the Filipino helper had touched her genitals on several occasions between May and June 2025. The...
featured.titleZh: 一名外籍女佣因猥亵雇主12岁女儿被判入狱5个月
featured.summaryZh: 香港一名45岁外籍女佣因在雇主家中多次猥亵其12岁女儿，被九龙城裁判法院判处监禁5个月。被告此前被裁定三项非礼罪名成立，庭审期间曾多次落泪。
featured.whyImportant: 此案凸显了家庭内部未成年人保护及外籍家政人员法律责任的严肃性。

featured.title: Hong Kong privacy watchdog backs tighter rules on access to land records
featured.summary: Hong Kong’s privacy watchdog has backed a proposed overhaul of rules to tighten access to land records, warning that journalists have no exemption when collecting data as complaints over information misuse appear to be worsening. Privacy Commissioner Ada Chung Lai-ling said on Friday that journalists do not enjoy an exemption under the Privacy Ordinance when gathering information, even though certain safeguards apply to how the data is subsequently used. “The Privacy Ordinance does provide an...
featured.titleZh: 香港隐私专员支持收紧土地记录查阅规则
featured.summaryZh: 香港个人资料私隐专员公署支持收紧土地记录查阅规则，并明确指出记者在收集数据时并不享有《个人资料（私隐）条例》下的豁免权。专员钟丽玲强调，尽管数据后续使用有一定保障，但收集过程仍需符合隐私法规。
featured.whyImportant: 此举反映了香港在平衡新闻自由与个人隐私保护方面正面临更严格的监管趋势。

featured.title: Why is Iran exempting India, China, Qatar, Iraq from Hormuz restrictions?
featured.summary: Tehran says ships from four countries can cross Hormuz freely, but analysts say the deals carry political risks.
featured.titleZh: 伊朗为何豁免印度、中国、卡塔尔和伊拉克在霍尔木兹海峡的限制？
featured.summaryZh: 德黑兰宣布上述四国船只可自由通过霍尔木兹海峡。分析人士指出，此类豁免协议背后潜藏着复杂的政治风险。
featured.whyImportant: 该政策调整可能影响全球能源运输安全及中东地区的地缘政治博弈。

global.summary: Call comes as Iraq's top diplomat urges armed groups not to join any Iranian retaliation to US attacks.
global.titleZh: 伊拉克官员与特朗普通话，巴格达寻求置身于伊朗战争之外
global.summaryZh: 在伊拉克外交官敦促国内武装组织不要参与伊朗对美国的任何报复行动之际，伊拉克官员与特朗普进行了通话。巴格达正努力避免被卷入美伊冲突。
global.whyImportant: 伊拉克在美伊紧张局势中的立场对中东地区的稳定具有关键影响。

global.titleZh: 美国国会“蓝色浪潮”扩大——实时报道
global.summaryZh: 美国中期选举之夜出现了多项意外结果和激烈的选区竞争。目前民主党在国会选举中表现强劲，密西西比州的参议院席位争夺尤为胶着。
global.whyImportant: 选举结果将直接决定美国未来两年的立法方向及政治权力格局。

global.title: Beau Lamarre-Condon trial: prosecution begins cross-examination of double murder accused – as it happened
global.summary: This blog has now closed Beau Lamarre-Condon tells double murder trial shooting of Jesse Baird wasn’t intentional but ‘it was my fault’ Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast Lamarre-Condon tells the court he had seen what he assumed to be someone’s delivery motorcycle: As soon as I saw that I had an idea … I saw a hi-vis hooded jacket, waterproof long pants and gloves. This moment here … I wish that I didn’t do this … But I had the thought process that if I was to put on this helmet and outfit I could knock on Jesse’s door I would look like an UberEats driver without any verbal interaction with Jesse. At the very least I would have had an AVO out against me … police don’t hesitate to put another police on an AVO … I was worried if I knocked on the door it would be perceived as harassment. Continue reading...
global.titleZh: 博·拉马尔-康登双重谋杀案审判：检方开始盘问被告
global.summaryZh: 被告博·拉马尔-康登在双重谋杀案审判中供述，枪杀杰西·贝尔德并非蓄意，但承认是自己的过错。他声称当时伪装成外卖员是为了避免与受害者发生言语冲突。
global.whyImportant: 此案因涉及前警员身份及恶性谋杀指控，在澳大利亚引发了广泛的社会关注。

global.title: Liberal bus crashes into shop awning on its first outing of Victorian election campaign
global.summary: Opposition leader Jess Wilson grimaces as the ‘Jess Express’, carrying Liberals and reporters, backs into the structure in suburban Melbourne Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast The Victorian Liberal party’s first offical day on the campaign trail has hit a snag, after its campaign bus reversed into the awning of a shopfront. The “Jess Express”, a large blue bus emblazoned with an image of the opposition leader, Jess Wilson, was unveiled on Friday, 12 days after Labor launched its own red equivalent. Continue reading...
global.titleZh: 维多利亚州选举竞选活动首日，自由党竞选巴士撞上商店遮阳篷
global.summaryZh: 维多利亚州自由党在竞选活动首日遭遇尴尬，其名为“杰西快车”的竞选巴士在倒车时撞上了墨尔本郊区一家商店的遮阳篷。该巴士旨在为反对党领袖杰西·威尔逊的竞选造势。
global.whyImportant: 竞选期间的意外事故可能对候选人的公众形象及竞选节奏产生负面影响。

global.title: Netanyahu rival Eisenkot tipped to seek Israeli government with backing of Arab lists
global.summary: Israeli President Isaac Herzog said he will announce on Sunday whom he will task with trying to form a new government, after the opposition’s Gadi Eisenkot secured a commanding number of recommendations to replace Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. Herzog held a second day of consultations with political parties on Thursday after the October 27 election, in which neither Netanyahu - a polarising right-winger who has led Israel through three years of war - nor Eisenkot - a former military chief...
global.titleZh: 内塔尼亚胡竞争对手艾森科特有望在阿拉伯政党支持下组建以色列政府
global.summaryZh: 以色列总统赫尔佐格将于周日宣布组阁人选。前军事首长艾森科特在选举后获得了足够的推荐，有望取代现任总理内塔尼亚胡组建新政府。
global.whyImportant: 以色列政权的更迭将对该国未来的战争政策及中东外交走向产生深远影响。

global.title: Overseas institutions keen on Hong Kong university towns, happy to help local peers
global.summary: Leaders of overseas institutions have expressed keen interest in taking part in Hong Kong’s planned university towns in the Northern Metropolis megaproject and stress that while financing remains a challenge, they will collaborate on activities to help ensure projects are financially viable. The university heads also called on the Hong Kong government to provide affordable housing in the new university towns, roll out policy incentives to retain top global talent and clearly define what success...
global.titleZh: 海外机构热衷于香港大学城项目，愿协助本地同行
global.summaryZh: 海外高校领导层对参与香港北部都会区大学城项目表现出浓厚兴趣。他们强调尽管融资存在挑战，但愿通过合作确保项目财务可行性，并呼吁政府提供住房支持及人才激励政策。
global.whyImportant: 此举反映了香港在打造国际教育枢纽过程中，对吸引全球顶尖学术资源与资本合作的迫切需求。

global.title: California governor commutes sentences for state's 548 death row inmates
global.summary: ⁠California Governor Gavin Newsom said on Thursday he will commute the death sentences of all 548 inmates currently condemned to execution in his state, the largest death row in the western hemisphere, declaring he believes capital punishment to be morally wrong. The announcement, in a three-page letter addressed to “all Californians”, came as Newsom, a Democrat who is expected to seek his party’s presidential nomination in 2028, neared the end of his second and final four-year term as...
global.titleZh: 加州州长将该州548名死囚的刑期减为终身监禁
global.summaryZh: 加州州长加文·纽森宣布，将把该州所有548名死囚的死刑减为终身监禁。他表示此举源于其认为死刑在道德上是错误的，该决定在其任期末尾做出。
global.whyImportant: 作为美国拥有最大死囚群体的州，此举对美国关于死刑存废的法律与道德辩论具有重大影响。

items.titleZh: 巴拉圭总统在银行危机导致数百万人储蓄被冻结后辞职
items.summaryZh: 巴拉圭右翼总统圣地亚哥·培尼亚在国家银行系统崩溃后宣布辞职。此前，其政府授权Ueno银行大幅扩张业务，该银行在短时间内迅速成为该国最大的贷款机构之一，拥有大量客户。
items.whyImportant: 此次总统辞职和银行危机对巴拉圭的政治稳定及金融体系造成了严重冲击。

items.title: White House denies Hegseth and Rubio to leave jobs after Republican election losses
items.summary: US media reports there are calls to replace Pete Hegseth, who also faces a possible impeachment vote, while Mark Rubio is rumoured to be eyeing a presidential run.
items.titleZh: 白宫否认赫格塞斯和卢比奥在共和党选举失利后离职
items.summaryZh: 美国媒体报道称，有呼声要求撤换皮特·赫格塞斯，且他可能面临弹劾投票。同时，有传言称马可·卢比奥正考虑竞选总统。
items.whyImportant: 此消息涉及美国政府高层的人事变动传闻，引发了外界对共和党内部政治动向的关注。

items.title: Pope begins lengthy trip to Latin America weeks after lung cancer surgery
items.summary: Pope Leo, who had part of a lung removed last month, will visit Uruguay, Argentina and Peru.
items.titleZh: 教皇在肺癌手术数周后开启拉美长途访问
items.summaryZh: 教皇利奥在上个月接受了部分肺切除手术，目前已启程前往乌拉圭、阿根廷和秘鲁进行访问。这是他术后的首次长途行程。
items.whyImportant: 教皇的健康状况及其外交行程对天主教界及相关访问国家具有重要意义。

items.title: Trump signs order preventing future presidents from changing Oval Office
items.summary: The order comes after Trump made a series of big changes to the decor of the Oval Office and tore down the White House East Wing.
items.titleZh: 特朗普签署行政令，禁止未来总统更改椭圆形办公室
items.summaryZh: 特朗普此前对椭圆形办公室的装饰进行了大幅改动，并拆除了白宫东翼。此次签署的行政令旨在限制继任者对办公室进行类似的变动。
items.whyImportant: 此举通过行政手段限制了未来总统对白宫核心办公区域的处置权，引发了关于总统权力和办公空间管理的讨论。

items.title: Global tech stocks plunge as US midterms add to AI slowdown fears
items.summary: Investors have reacted to possible tougher scrutiny of data centre construction and the AI industry.
items.titleZh: 全球科技股暴跌，美国中期选举加剧对人工智能放缓的担忧
items.summaryZh: 投资者对数据中心建设及人工智能行业可能面临更严格监管的预期做出反应。受此影响，全球科技股出现大幅下跌。
items.whyImportant: 市场对监管政策的担忧直接影响了全球科技行业的投资信心和股价表现。

items.title: A wildfire killed their loved ones in Spain. These British families demand to know why
items.summary: Nine British nationals were among the 15 people who died when fire ripped through the village of Bédar this summer.
items.titleZh: 西班牙野火夺走亲人生命，英国遇难者家属要求查明真相
items.summaryZh: 今年夏天，西班牙贝达尔村发生严重火灾，造成15人死亡，其中包括9名英国公民。遇难者家属目前正寻求了解火灾发生的具体原因。
items.whyImportant: 这起悲剧引发了关于公共安全责任和跨国遇难者家属维权的关注。

items.title: Hong Kong police to enable AI facial recognition on CCTV network this month
items.summary: Hong Kong police will enable artificial intelligence-powered facial recognition technology across their expanding smart surveillance network this month to improve the tracking of missing persons or suspects, with plans to save the data it generates for up to 180 days. items.titleZh: 香港警方本月将在闭路电视网络启用人工智能人脸识别技术
items.summaryZh: 香港警方计划在本月启用人工智能人脸识别技术，以提升追踪失踪人员或嫌疑人的效率。警方表示该技术将广泛应用于监控网络，并承诺会保护居民的隐私权。
items.whyImportant: 此举标志着香港在公共安全监控领域进一步引入先进技术，引发了公众对隐私保护和监控范围的讨论。
